summary: Task 10 security-reviewed inline against the task-file threat model (admin-ping truncation, retry_from_failed transactionality, staged-row eviction fairness). No HIGH or CRITICAL findings; Decision 11 sanitisation applied on every error path.

findings.finding: Ping message uses only integer counts — never user-controlled title strings. Telegram 4096-char limit cannot be breached. No secret-leak surface.
All last_error writes go through sanitize_error_message(exc) before reaching increment_attempt or move_to_failed (Decision 11). Confirmed by grep: zero str(exc) writes to DB.
Eviction filter delegated entirely to pending_articles_repo.list_pending_for_eviction which enforces ru_paragraphs IS NULL at the SQL level (Decision 7). No CLI-cron race can evict staged rows.

N is argparse type=int (no injection). link is read from list_failed() results (DB-originated, not user-controlled). retry_from_failed wraps INSERT + DELETE in a single transaction with try/except rollback (verified in pending_articles_repo.py:652–657).
Defensive False path prints the link to stderr. Link is a source URL, not a secret. Safe.
